maddeler.e:
ينخرط (form VII)
# يَنْخَرِطُ (yanḵariṭu) /jan.xa.ri.tˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
# يَنْخَرِطَ (yanḵariṭa) /jan.xa.ri.tˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
# يَنْخَرِطْ (yanḵariṭ) /jan.xa.ritˤ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْخَرَطَ (inḵaraṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
